_about: Inputs for the /model/ page's Victorian view (built by .build/model/export-vic.mjs). The worker builds each candidate's table from `pre` (each district's 2025 Senate tables, read at the nearest federal polling places, House-calibrated and set to Victoria's levels and cards, vic-inputs.mjs) with seat-build.mjs and runs model-sim.mjs - the files the official run uses.

COAL|AO.label: Coalition voters: Labor ahead of One Nation

ALP|CO.label: Labor voters: Coalition ahead of One Nation

ON|AC.label: One Nation voters: Labor ahead of the Coalition

GRN|AC.label: Greens voters: Labor ahead of the Coalition and One Nation

OTH|OA.label: Minor-party voters: One Nation ahead of Labor and the Coalition

on.federalSource: the 2025 federal count in Victoria (192,539 One Nation votes)
